## Summary

A short description of what this PR changes and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that changes existing behavior)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring / cleanup (no functional change)
- [ ] Build / CI / tooling change

## Related issues

Closes #<issue-number>
Relates to #<issue-number>

## How has this been tested?

Describe the tests you ran and how to reproduce them.

- [ ] `dotnet build InfraStream.CI.slnx` passes locally
- [ ] `dotnet test InfraStream.CI.slnx` passes locally
- [ ] New tests added (if applicable)
- [ ] Manual verification (describe below)

## Checklist

- [ ] My commits are signed off (`Signed-off-by` line present)
- [ ] All comments, XML-doc, log messages, and exception messages are in English
- [ ] Public APIs have XML-doc
- [ ] No new allocations on the hot path (or discussed in an issue)
- [ ] `.editorconfig` rules respected
- [ ] I have updated documentation where relevant (README, docs/, examples/)
- [ ] I have not introduced GPL/AGPL/commercial dependencies (see CONTRIBUTING.md §Dependencies)

Anything specific you want reviewers to look at: tricky parts, open
